data.long_meaning: The name Kanish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kanishka', which means 'Lord Shiva'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is the god of destruction and the supreme deity. He is also known as the 'God of Gods' and the 'Lord of the Universe'. The name Kanish carries the meaning “Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanish usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
